*[Full literal translation of 22 verses with Hebrew transliterations]*

## EMET's Textual Notes

**Key verse — "I shall go softly all my years because of the bitt...":** Fifteen years added. EMET preserves the Hebrew structure and word order throughout, with bracketed transliterations for all significant terms.
